scope: In-memory diagnostic of experimental private Float64 indexed geometry, not an enabled restore path
sourceObservations: The asynchronous Flip admission and exact-indexed admission accept ordinary arrays and Float32 vertices, but not the marked private Float64 vertices accepted by synchronous indexed validation.
The component compact-path dispatch also requires ordinary position arrays; direct Float64 retention would skip that path.

Flip currently constructs Float32 output and indexed vertices; preserving compatibility and the intended precision requires a complete operation and worker-boundary review before enabling Float64 restore.
limitations: This is a small in-memory diagnostic, not a browser, MCP, native or resource acceptance test. Float64 restore remains disabled.
